messages.author: Pauli Paneeli
messages.text: Vuokko, I'm at the Rauta site. ge-0/0/2 is showing CRC errors, not many but they keep coming.

messages.author: Vuokko Virtalähde
messages.text: Only ge-0/0/2 at Rauta, or ge-0/0/1 as well?

messages.author: Vuokko Virtalähde
messages.text: Then I doubt it's the unit itself. Slow CRC errors on one port like that at Rauta are usually the patch lead. Swap the lead on ge-0/0/2 first and clear the counters. If they come back, clean the connector and then try the SFP.

messages.author: Pauli Paneeli
messages.text: New lead in, counters cleared. Zero so far.
